contradictions.topic: Old gateway and header vs current API
contradictions.right_claim: Migration Guide requires Authorization and gateway.api.bot.or.th
contradictions.decision: Current migration guide and product-specific docs govern present machine access; legacy becomes history only.
contradictions.closure_route: Revalidate if BOT issues another migration.

contradictions.right_claim: Manual explicitly states cart Product not yet approved; submit request then Approved Access
contradictions.decision: Cart selection = request preparation, not entitlement; R1 had already stated this correctly.
contradictions.closure_route: No further closure needed; future account evidence only for specific approval.

contradictions.topic: TOKEN vs TOKEN HASH vs APP ID
contradictions.left_claim: BOT credential UI has three distinct labels; Token described as unique app ID
contradictions.right_claim: Manual instructs Copy Token into Authorization; TOKEN HASH described as app/auth server password
contradictions.decision: Separation of fields and documented copied Token path are supported; TOKEN HASH technical/on-wire role cannot be deduced.
contradictions.closure_route: Explicit current BOT specification/provider answer; authorized account test when secure.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: BOT publishes matching field definitions and wire examples.

contradictions.topic: Auth Token / API Key / authToken terminology
contradictions.left_claim: Product UI says Auth Token, screenshot says authToken
contradictions.right_claim: Indexed API documentation uses API Key; Manual says Authorization header with copied Token
contradictions.decision: Different UI and security-scheme labels are not evidence of OAuth/JWT/Bearer semantics; header name and documented copy path stand.
contradictions.closure_route: Save official raw current API spec and secure positive test; clarify exact credential type with BOT.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Versioned source explicitly defines auth scheme/token formats.

contradictions.topic: Existing App text vs selection control
contradictions.left_claim: Manual Thai prose describes creating app using earlier name and separate Product
contradictions.right_claim: Illustration radio control says Existing app; actual reuse/credential sharing not specified
contradictions.decision: Only option existence is proven; no inference about shared token, multi-product approval or actual reuse.
contradictions.closure_route: Explicit BOT app/product cardinality docs or authorized redacted portal workflow.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: BOT clarifies Existing App backend behavior.

contradictions.topic: Statistics Manual rate vs current Product rate
contradictions.left_claim: Official unversioned Manual screenshot: 1000 calls per minute
contradictions.right_claim: Current live-displayed Statistics Product: 2000 calls per hour
contradictions.decision: A genuine two-source configuration-text mismatch; current page authoritative for current advertised number only. Cause/version/scope/enforcement UNKNOWN.
contradictions.closure_route: Dated plan/version/config history or BOT support clarification; lawful measured configuration if available.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Versioned authoritative schedule explains both snapshots.

contradictions.right_claim: Same plan says Rate 2000 calls per hour
contradictions.decision: They are separately displayed dimensions; unlimited quota is NOT permission for unlimited call frequency.
contradictions.closure_route: Enforcement interpretation still separately unknown under R5.

contradictions.decision: No BOT-wide single rate; different Product/Plan displays coexist. Actual per-token enforcement remains unknown.
contradictions.closure_route: No contradiction to close; record per-product advertised plan only.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Rate pages or actual enforcement contract changes.

contradictions.topic: Displayed plan rate vs actual enforcement
contradictions.right_claim: No authenticated/over-limit HTTP or headers observed in R3–R5
contradictions.decision: Display does not define enforcement key, window algorithm, Retry-After, 429 or reset headers.
contradictions.closure_route: Explicit BOT enforcement contract or naturally encountered safe origin HTTP evidence; no stress testing.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: BOT publishes measured limiter scope and headers.

contradictions.left_claim: BOT Manual illustrates 200 OK after successful Postman example
contradictions.right_claim: R3 produced zero live authenticated requests due to unavailable approved credential in this agent context
contradictions.decision: Demonstration is not project runtime evidence; live positive auth stays BLOCKED without a fabricated 200.
contradictions.closure_route: One legitimate token-bearing safe request from trusted runtime, separately recorded.

contradictions.topic: Dashboard 403 illustration vs R4 zero HTTP
contradictions.left_claim: BOT Dashboard example displays 403 Forbidden in pie chart
contradictions.right_claim: R4 local curl failed DNS and observed no BOT Gateway HTTP response
contradictions.decision: UI error category existence does not classify actual gateway errors; R4 has no origin 403/401/429.
contradictions.closure_route: Safe origin negative request after network preconditions; retain raw status as observed.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: New real safe error response is captured.

contradictions.topic: Local DNS failure vs externally readable BOT web docs
contradictions.left_claim: R4 runner could not resolve portal/gateway and curl http_code=000
contradictions.right_claim: A separate web reader can retrieve official BOT Portal documents
contradictions.decision: Different clients/surfaces; local resolver failure is not evidence BOT is down, and public documentation retrieval does not establish gateway egress.
contradictions.closure_route: Use an authorized egress-enabled runner and measure origin HTTP; no extrapolation.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Controlled comparison from same runner shows gateway transport.

contradictions.right_claim: Same BOT page English notice ends 11:00 PM (23:00)
contradictions.decision: A real official textual time contradiction; neither 2-hour nor 14-hour downtime is proven. Preserve BOTH strings.
contradictions.closure_route: BOT corrected notice or explicit official clarification including local timezone.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Official corrigendum explicitly resolves the interval.

contradictions.topic: Past maintenance notice vs current service health
contradictions.left_claim: Official notice announces planned interruption on 3 Oct
contradictions.right_claim: Research performed 8 Oct; no current status API/actual measured outage
contradictions.decision: Historical announcement cannot prove outage on research date or actual downtime duration.
contradictions.closure_route: Separately establish service-health source; no current-outage claim.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: New time-scoped official outage evidence appears.

contradictions.topic: Rotate/Revoke and Never example vs actual lifecycle
contradictions.left_claim: BOT app screenshot shows ROTATE, REVOKE, EXPIRES Never
contradictions.right_claim: No approved account/real rotate, revoke, expiry, propagation or overlap tested
contradictions.decision: UI controls exist as illustrated; no global permanent credential lifetime or revocation guarantee.
contradictions.closure_route: Provider lifecycle policy or controlled owner-authorized test; no real secrets in issue/docs.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: BOT publishes or demonstrates actual lifecycle semantics.

contradictions.topic: GitHub encrypted Secrets vs public GitHub/Pages
contradictions.left_claim: GitHub offers restricted Secrets and environment approvals in general
contradictions.right_claim: Repo PUBLIC; current Pages deploy copies PROJECT_STATE.json, docs/, releases/, schemas/ from source
contradictions.decision: Secret-store features do not make tracked public files confidential; checked workflows do not explicitly contain BOT secret references; no full secret scan or incident evidence.
contradictions.closure_route: Approved settings audit and canary controls later; design risk OPEN not current breach.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: New audited runtime or actual leak evidence.

contradictions.topic: Security design contract vs operational security certification
contradictions.left_claim: R6 writes a comprehensive secret-boundary design
contradictions.right_claim: No private manager/worker, canary test or bot credential security controls implemented
contradictions.decision: R6 is DESIGN RECORDED ONLY, no SEC-G01..SEC-G12 operational PASS and no connector authorization.
contradictions.closure_route: Future reviewed implementation tests only after Issue #11 research gate.

contradictions.topic: Indexed BOT Statistics API detail vs direct HTML extraction
contradictions.left_claim: R2 search-indexed BOT-source excerpt exposed API Key/Authorization example
contradictions.right_claim: Direct docs URL renders only page shell in public text retrieval; no immutable OpenAPI export
contradictions.decision: Manual/migration independently corroborate header, but raw versioned API spec export URL/history remains unproven.
contradictions.closure_route: Obtain official spec export directly with bytes/version/checksum or explicit BOT support source.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: BOT makes stable spec export/history verifiably retrievable.

contradictions.left_claim: R2 re-fetched primary sources instead of accepting R1 conclusions
contradictions.right_claim: The same assistant conducted R1 and R2; Day-01 closure audit was also a same-agent self-audit
contradictions.decision: Independent source challenge is not independent third-party semantic certification or live BOT behavior verification.
contradictions.closure_route: Independent reviewer recommended later; structural CI proves repository consistency only.
contradictions.invalidation_condition: Third-party independent semantic audit becomes available.
